pages.text: Hold the $(thing)Thermometer$() to read the air temperature: coldest at dawn, warmest in mid-afternoon. Use it for today's low and high, a frost warning and tomorrow's forecast.

Push the $(thing)Soil Moisture Meter$() into soil, farmland or a crop's roots: water content, how much plants can still draw, whether it is waterlogged, and how many mm of water would refill the root zone.
